Name: (CP) Cerri's working televisions
Author: CerridwynMorgana
Description:
Replaces vanilla game televisions with televisions that coordinate with other Cerri's mods .

Because my mod directly replaces the game plasma tv, this mod is not compatible with other mods that replace plasma tv, including my other tv mod, Cerri's working televisions CES . 

Functions as a regular tv.

Downloads.Description: Working  tvs that coordinate with other Cerri's mods but don't require them.

Manifest.Description: Two working tvs that are stand alone replacers of the plasma and budget TVs.
